text:
Eli: Ferry lineup chaos this morning. 8:15 turned into 9:00. Anyone else?
commute-bot: FERRY ALERT: Pier 5 heavy boarding volumes; expect 25-40min delays.
Dani: Yep. Saw a tiny band doing covers near the ticket kiosk. Cute distraction. :notes:
Priya: Lost my left boot in the mud outside the station. Found it by the bike rack but it looks like it went to war. :boot: :sob:
Marcus: Wind on the bridge was brutal, almost lost my commute playlist to the gusts (and my dignity). :wind_face:
Eli: Office update 10: lower lobby mat is soaked today. Maybe park on the rooftop if you can.
Dani: I left two pairs of disposable shoe covers in the kitchen labeled "emergency footwear". Help yourselves. :handshake:
Priya: :raised_hands: grabbing one at lunch. Also if anyone finds a charcoal beanie with a green tag, that's mine.
commute-bot: MUNI: Routes 8 and 14 experiencing ~10-15min delays due to signal issues.
Marcus: Quick poll: pizza or bagels at 12 for soggy commuters? React :pizza: or :bagel:
Eli: :pizza:
Dani: :bagel:
Priya: :bagel:
Marcus: Cool. I'll order whichever wins by noon. Thanks for the shoe-cover donation folks.
Eli: PS if you have a spare microfiber cloth, drop it by reception. There's a puddle under the east column.
Dani: Noted. Also, found someone's sunglasses by the bench near Pier 5  left them on lost-and-found table.
Priya: Thanks! See you all at 12 (with soggy grace)
